title: Middleware Pipeline
description: Build an Express/Koa-style middleware pipeline with async support, error handling, and context.

steps.title: Create Middleware Data Structure
steps.description: Define a middleware function signature: `(ctx, next) => void` where `ctx` is a plain object and `next` is a function. Create an array of 3 sample middleware functions that print their name (e.g., `'Middleware: logger'`). Print the registered pipeline array.
hints: Each middleware receives context and calls next() to pass control
Use `console.log` inside each middleware for identification
Store middlewares in an array — order determines execution sequence

verification.successMessage: Middleware data structure and signatures are correctly defined

steps.title: Implement Basic Pipeline Execution
steps.description: Build a `compose` function that takes an array of middleware and returns a function. When called with `ctx`, it runs each middleware in sequence by passing `next` that invokes the next middleware in the chain. Print `'Executing: name'` before each middleware runs.
hints: Use recursion or a loop that chains next functions together
The last middleware's next should be a no-op that returns undefined
Middleware must call next() for the chain to continue

verification.successMessage: Pipeline executes all middlewares in the correct order
verification.failureMessage: Pipeline did not execute all middlewares

steps.title: Add Async Middleware Support
steps.description: Make the pipeline support async middleware functions. Modify the `compose` function to handle promises: each `next()` call should `await` the result. Create an async middleware that does `await delay(10)` (simulated with `setTimeout` wrapped in a Promise) and prints `'Async: done'`.
hints: Wrap setTimeout in a Promise to create a delay helper
Make compose return a promise chain using reduce or recursion with async/await
If a middleware returns a promise, await it before calling the next

verification.successMessage: Async middleware executes correctly with await-based pipeline
verification.failureMessage: Async middleware did not complete execution

steps.title: Implement Error Handling Middleware
steps.description: Add error handling to the pipeline. When a middleware throws or rejects, the pipeline should skip remaining normal middlewares and jump to the nearest error handler middleware. Error handlers have signature `(err, ctx, next)`. Print `'Error caught: message'` when an error handler is invoked.
hints: Detect error handlers by checking the function's parameter count (length === 3)
Wrap each middleware call in try/catch and pass the error to the next error handler
If no error handler exists, let the error propagate out of compose

verification.successMessage: Error middleware correctly catches and handles errors
verification.failureMessage: Error was not caught by the error handling middleware

steps.title: Add Context Object with State
steps.description: Enrich the `ctx` object with `req` and `res` properties. Each middleware can mutate `ctx` (e.g., add `ctx.user`, `ctx.body`). Build a middleware that sets `ctx.user = {id: 1, role: 'admin'}` and another that sets `ctx.body = 'Hello'`. After running the pipeline, print the final `ctx` state as JSON.
hints: Middleware mutates ctx by assigning properties like ctx.user

verification.successMessage: Context state is correctly mutated and printed
verification.failureMessage: Context mutations were not reflected in final state

steps.title: Build Composable Route Handler
steps.description: Create a `Router` class with `get(path, ...middlewares)` and `post(path, ...middlewares)` methods. The router stores route-specific middleware chains keyed by method+path. Add a `match(method, path)` method that returns the composed middleware chain for a given route. Print `'Route matched: GET /users'` on match.
hints: Store routes as `{method, path, middlewares[]}` in an array
Use simple string comparison for path matching initially
The match method should return a composed function using your existing compose

verification.successMessage: Router correctly matches and composes route-specific middleware chains
verification.failureMessage: Router did not match the expected route
